The live site never reads this file: with a Places API key set in page.html it fetches Google on every page load, because Google's policy forbids storing reviews. Authors are linked to their Google profiles.

text.text:
Really fun and welcoming place to train BJJ. Everyone was super friendly and there was absolutely no ego. We started with basic movements and breakfalls before moving into controls and submissions, with everything explained clearly and patiently.

I also really liked the stretching and Q&A at the end of class, which I haven't seen at other gyms. Great atmosphere and definitely a place I'd train at again!

I stopped by Valor Jiujitsu to take a free trial class. The gym was clean, well organized, and I appreciated the small touches like extra hair ties and hair dryer in the women’s locker room. The instructors, Professor David and Coach Jando, were both welcoming. Warm-ups, drills, and sparring kicked my butt! I’ll definitely be back.

My daughter and I came in so she can try out Jiu-Jitsu for the first time she fell in love within 10 min. Coach David, Coach Jando and Coach Jason are great with kids. We signed up right after the class. Amazing place.
Great and dedicated instructors that help with every step of the way from beginners to experience students. Friendly and welcoming environment, and very happy with my daughter's experience.

Tried an early 6 AM class here today. Really impressed with this place, the mats are super clean, professors and coaches are friendly and knowledgeable. I love their unique approach to bjj, their class structure is quite different to conventional bjj schools. Every class ends with a group Q&A which is super helpful for beginners like me to ask any questions or problems I had during rolling! Keep up the great work guys!
